articles.title: Are perps swaps? A quick look at that CME suit: State of Crypto
articles.snippet: CME Group sued the CFTC on Thursday, alleging that the agency was wrong in how it approved Kalshi's first U.S. perpetual futures product.

articles.title: Ethereum's biggest 'sandwich' bot drained of $7.5 million in ironic exploit
articles.snippet: Blockaid said an attacker tricked Jaredfromsubway.eth into approving fake trading routes, then used those approvals to drain WETH, USDC and USDT.

articles.title: Bitcoin holds near $64,000 as a renewed Hormuz threat clouds US-Iran ceasefire talks
articles.snippet: Crypto firmed over the weekend after Friday's sell-off, with bitcoin recovering toward $64,000. Permanent ceasefire talks open in Switzerland, but Iran's order to close the Strait of Hormuz again revives the risk the deal was meant to settle.

articles.title: AI is making crypto security cheaper, faster and harder to ignore
articles.snippet: As AI-powered security tools become cheaper, faster and more widely available, researchers said they could reshape what the crypto industry considers reasonable due diligence before deploying code, potentially altering expectations for developers and institutions.

articles.title: How STRC lost its par: The timeline behind Strategy's preferred-stock meltdown
articles.snippet: From a bond buyback and dwindling cash reserves to a bitcoin bear market, the sequence of events that turned STRC's par-value challenge into a marketwide debate.
